Tiny clustered plants, designed to be readable when the entire ground footprint is 64 world pixels wide. Root points stay small and clean.

Natural variation of blade lean without random rotation of the ground footprint.
Critical avoid: NO soil, dirt, rocks, stones, pebbles, raised beds, mounds, ground island, pedestal, tray, tile border, grid, grass lawn, cast shadow on the ground, glow, outline, UI, lettering, characters, tools, animals or scenery. NO thick succulent or corn leaves. Real alpha transparency, not a painted checkerboard.

Keep the exact specified root footprint and canvas. The artwork contains only the six wheat tufts.
